summary_en: AirTrip will acquire up to 876,700 shares (3.7% of outstanding shares) for up to ¥681.2 million via ToSTNeT-3 on September 8, 2026, at ¥777 per share, to enhance shareholder returns and support future M&A activities.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Exchange Purchase Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
AirTrip Corp. announced on September 2, 2026, that its Board of Directors has decided to acquire up to 876,700 shares of treasury stock through an off-exchange block trade via ToSTNeT-3. The acquisition is scheduled for September 8, 2026, at a fixed price of ¥777 per share, with a maximum acquisition cost of ¥681,195,900. This represents 3.9% of the 22,772,065 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of August 31, 2026.

The company stated that the buyback follows its previous treasury stock acquisition and is part of a strategic capital policy aimed at enhancing shareholder returns and securing funds for potential future M&A activities and business partnerships. This decision comes as AirTrip pursues its mid-to-long-term growth strategy "AirTrip 5000," targeting consolidated group transaction volume of ¥500 billion, with operating profit goals of ¥5 billion by fiscal year ending September 2028 and ¥10 billion thereafter. The counterparty has indicated willingness to participate in the transaction. The company will announce further details as they are finalized.
